symptoms_en: Nymphs and adults suck the sap of the flower panicles, so flower buds and flowers wither and drop; honeydew and sooty mould appear on the lower leaves.
symptoms_hi: शिशु और वयस्क बौर का रस चूसते हैं जिससे फूल और कलियाँ मुरझाकर झड़ती हैं; निचली पत्तियों पर शहद जैसा स्राव और कालिख जैसी फफूँद दिखती है।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of mango
symptoms_en.quote: Nymphs and adults suck the sap of inflorescence Withering Shedding of flower buds and flowers Presence of honey dew secrecation on lower leaves and development of sooty mould.

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of mango
management_en.quote: Avoid close planting, as the incidence very severe in overcrowded orchards. Orchards must be kept clean by ploughing and removal of weeds.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: For sucking pests (like thrips and whitefly) in the early stage: Spray Neemastra @ 200 litres per acre
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: Control of pink bollworm and jassids: Spray 5–7 litres of Brahmastra in 200 litres of water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

months.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of mango
months.quote: The insect appears in February when mango trees come to flowering.

management_en: Avoid close planting (attacks are worst in crowded orchards) and keep the orchard clean by ploughing and weeding.
management_hi: घनी रोपाई न करें (घने बाग में प्रकोप सबसे ज़्यादा होता है) और जुताई-निराई से बाग साफ़ रखें।
